# Snipsy

Snipsy is a text-expansion plugin for Obsidian: type a trigger and a space,
get the text. Hotstrings, a searchable snippet picker, community packages,
and Espanso import. It knows where markdown is code, so it stays quiet in
code blocks and frontmatter.

Site: https://dimagious.github.io/snipsidian/
Repository: https://github.com/Dimagious/snipsidian
Community plugin listing: https://community.obsidian.md/plugins/snipsidian
Plugin id: snipsidian
